# Fazefactory®

> Fazefactory® is a digital creative service, established in 2014 in Italy. The website at fazefactory.com is being revamped: the current page is a temporary home with the Fazefactory star, while the new site takes shape.

The page is a single interactive screen: the Fazefactory star moves through the red, yellow and blue primaries and can be poked, held, dragged and thrown. A headline rotates through eleven languages on the theme of "back in shape".

## Contact
